item.title: Version 1.9.1
item.description: Native integrations now run independently: a slow Calendar request no longer blocks Mail, Things, or other integrations. Requests to the same integration remain serialized across clients, and busy responses identify the affected integration. Existing tokens and selected sources keep their permissions. Includes all MacMCP 1.9 features. Universal Apple Silicon/Intel, Developer ID signed and notarized.

item.title: Version 1.9.0
item.description: Adds read-only iMessage history and search in conversations selected locally. Full Disk Access is required; iMessage starts disabled with no conversations selected and existing tokens keep their permissions. Also includes Chrome tools, dedicated persistent agent profiles, local takeover, an optional Browser Harness engine, and opening the first browser tab. No messages are sent. Universal Apple Silicon/Intel, Developer ID signed and notarized.

item.title: Version 1.4.0
item.description: Adds Obsidian vaults with locally selected folders and per-token read/write access. List, search, read, create, replace, append, and trash Markdown notes without a plugin. Revision checks and recoverable prior versions protect editing. Existing tokens and settings retain their permissions; Obsidian starts disabled with no vaults selected. Universal, Developer ID signed and notarized.
